title: nexus3.yaml
description: Per-repository nexus3 configuration file. Add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<path-to-repo-root>/docs/schema/nexus3.schema.json` as the first line of nexus3.yaml for editor autocomplete and validation.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1. A missing version field is a hard error.

allow.description: Additional hostnames the sandbox may reach. Merged (union) with --allow-host flags and the built-in perimeter allowlist; does not replace them.

sandbox.description: Per-repo sandbox defaults. Any field here is overridden by the corresponding CLI flag.

image.description: Container image name used when no --image flag is given.

memory.description: Sandbox RAM in MiB. 0 means use the built-in default.

vcpus.description: Number of virtual CPUs. 0 means use the built-in default.

mounts.description: List of host:guest mount entries, e.g. ".:/work". Relative host paths are resolved against the directory containing nexus3.yaml — not the process working directory. Superseded entirely by any --mount flag.

agent.description: Default agent profile name applied when no --agent flag is given (e.g. "claude-code"). Empty means no agent by default.
